purpose: Allow an authorization grant to be revoked at its grant timestamp and index active person-scoped role lookup.
lockImpact: Takes bounded locks while replacing one check constraint and creating a small reset-environment index.
dataImpact: No row changes; zero-duration grants become valid while timestamps before granted_at remain rejected.
backfill: Not required for the approved empty local-development reset.
destructiveApproval: Approved by ADR-0034 and the 2026-08-04 reset-only local-development migration plan; this replaces only the fixed-role timestamp constraint and retains all grant rows.
recovery: Retain the relaxed constraint and index during application rollback because both remain compatible with earlier valid rows.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed authorization-owned migration. Do not rewrite this migration after application.
